original_contract: Normal-source original test unchanged1000ms8x16/native/cwd/env/group/stdout/stderr/overflow/cancel. Trace overhead is diagnostic perturbation; success is not repair. No warmup/budget renewal/fixture substitution.
purpose: Different target-selection hypothesis: all-process detailed wait/kernel/user stacks may expose owned native child wait channel; prior launch-wrapper-only tables did not. No wait reason or cause guaranteed.
collection_scope: System Trace --all-processes7seconds; may collect unrelated apps user/kernel stacks, symbols, process identities, paths, VM, file and scheduling metadata in private raw. Ordinary OSLogs excluded. This broader stack collection requires explicit new approval.
retention: Raw mode0700 private directory, no sharing/commit; only exact owned root/child and approved syspolicyd/XprotectService numeric intervals/frames retained. Unrelated frames/symbols discarded. Bind trace-local process identity and TID, failed root receipt, and actual capture coverage before attribution. Missing stacks means unknown. No absolute kernel addresses, unrelated image names/paths/symbols or syscall arguments in public artifacts; approved frames normalized to image identity and offsets where safely possible.
authentication: Real macOS authentication if required; no bypass/no-prompt/password storage/service installation/security change.
readiness: Register unique owned Darwin FD listener before xctrace; launch original test once only after matching4byte big-endian token; missing signal/recorder exit/30s limit means no test. Notification itself does not prove full capture coverage.
size_limit_caveat: Outputstop checked every50ms; transient overshoot and Instruments-managed cache outside private output cannot be strictly byte-capped by this script.
cleanup: Recorder and listener terminal receipts; owned root watchdog/reap; exact known child and helper audit before raw deletion. Unknown full descendant enumeration remains unknown; no generic process kill. External Instruments cache not inspected/deleted.
review_evidence: Passive independent review approved after cleanup guards, explicit reaped/unknown states, exception-text masking and50ms caveat corrections. Six mocked coordinator fault controls subsequently passed; no real recording/test.
approval_evidence: User explicitly approved the concrete7second once-only1GiB all-process stack plan after disclosure of incidental other-app stacks; analysis restricted to owned test and approved services.
